From: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@atlasretail.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-20T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private-label runtime bundling for AtlasRetail POS

Hi Olga —

Quick intro: I lead Platform Partnerships at AtlasRetail. We're exploring packaging an LLM runtime into our POS and merchant analytics product as a private-label offering (Atlas+). Key asks:
- Is Redwood able to provide a private-label runtime (VPC or on-prem) that we can bundle under our brand?
- High-level pricing for two paths: dedicated reserved capacity for high-volume stores, and an on-prem option for enterprise accounts.
- Security: can we KMS-integrate and support our SSO (SAML)?
- SLAs, support model, and pilot timelines (30 store pilot → production).

I've attached a product brief so you can see where this will sit in our stack. Can you share a short pricing/integration overview and suggest next steps? Also looping in procurement (procurement@atlasretail.com) for timeline.

Thanks,
Julia Ramos
Platform Partnerships | AtlasRetail
[julia.ramos@atlasretail.com]
Attachment: atlas_confidential_product_brief.pdf

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@atlasretail.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private-label runtime bundling for AtlasRetail POS

Hi Julia — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the brief — clear product fit. TL;DR: yes, we can support a private-label runtime and two delivery patterns that match what you outlined.

What I'm attaching:
- redwood-oem-pricing-matrix.xlsx (pricing bands for Dedicated vs Private)
- integration-checklist.md (high-level touchpoints: onboarding, SSO/KMS, telemetry, snapshots)

High-level notes:
- Dedicated reserved capacity: predictable throughput, per-month seat/throughput pricing + commitment discounts (good for >5k requests/day).
- Private (VPC or on-prem): one-time packaging fee + annual support/maintenance + optional enterprise licensing.
- Security: SAML, KMS integrations, and SOC2 logs supported; we can onboard to your KMS/HSM.
- SLAs: 99.9% uptime target for Dedicated; Private deployments include an operational support plan with response SLAs.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-min technical scoping this week (we can have an engineer join)
2) share procurement contact / PO template
3) we draft a short SOW and pilot plan (2–4 week integration pilot)

Proposed timeslots: Thu 07/22 09:00 or 13:00 PT. Which works?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-oem-pricing-matrix.xlsx; integration-checklist.md

Folks — forwarding the AtlasRetail brief. They want to bundle a private-label runtime into their POS. Quick asks:
- Sergio: can you confirm margin targets and whether we should propose a revenue-share vs fixed license model?
- Karthik: can we allocate an engineer for the scoping call (SSO/KMS + short pilot support)?
- Vanessa: pricing + sales playbook updates (reseller channel) — any existing marketplace/partner terms we should surface?

Suggested initial pricing outline (from pricing matrix):
- Pilot: waived packaging fee for first pilot stores, fixed eng hours (40h)
- Production Dedicated: tiered monthly fee + per-transaction token unit pricing
- Private on-prem: up-front packaging + annual support (negotiable for enterprise)

I'll book a 30-min scoping call for Thu 07/22 09:00 PT if that works.

—Olga
